title: A Software-Only Thermal Proxy for Edge AI Inference on Raspberry Pi 5
description: Reproducible artifact for CPU Utilization as a Software-Only Thermal Proxy for Multi-Tenant Edge AI Inference (under review): a 13-hour telemetry campaign on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76) and a cross-validated coupling law between CPU utilization and SoC temperature. Includes the de-duplicated telemetry (Parquet, 5 Hz), the fitting scripts and the figures.
